GENERAL (cont'd.)
In the light of these facts and the critical resource situation of our region we, as concerned citizens of Upper South Carolina, object strongly to the continued loss of our valuable and unreplaceable habitats. Upper South Carolina has, and continues to become, a main area which is being sacrificed to produce power for other Southeastern areas. In view of our critical resource situation, we simply can give no more of our valuable resources to this project and the others planned for this basin. The Applicant, as a public service company, must consider South Carolina's relative ability to give more of its shrinking valuable resources versus the wholly economic benefit of development of this project.
No comment required.
